name: @custar/tutor-core
description: The CUSTAR tutor: PII redaction, the safety router, prompts and grounding, the tutor turn pipeline, the offline Tutor Lite engine and the SSE stream codec. Pure TypeScript (no React, Expo or Supabase); runs in Deno edge functions, Node and the learner app. Entry points: '.' (server side: everything), './client' (what the learner app may import: contract, voice, Tutor Lite and the stream codec; no model code), './fakes'.
